ui.design_rationale: The shopping search experience and friendly clickable product suggestions call for a warm, consumer-oriented amber palette with approachable typography.

files.purpose: Add a public search_suggestions endpoint that returns the exact four suggested query strings.
Fetch the suggested queries on mount and render clickable Try: suggestions that fill the search query.

verify.steps: Open Search and confirm the four Try: suggestions appear; click one and verify its text fills the search query input.

build_log.last_action: Created a focused feature plan for suggestions endpoint and SearchPage mount integration.

assumption: The current app shell and all other routes remain unchanged; only the existing catalog service and SearchPage require edits.
